result.brief: 提出 LpWM，用 Rectified 广义高斯分布匹配正则（RDMReg）在 JEPA 中学习非负稀疏潜表征，降低动作条件动力学预测器复杂度并揭示模式分解结构。
result.reason: JEPA world model with sparse latent representation regularization (RDMReg) for action-conditioned latent dynamics and planning; directly a representation-learning contribution for world models.
